description: Consult distilled personas of colleagues — build them from Slack history (distill-slack-persona), get a single colleague's take (ask-colleague), or convene a deliberating panel (ask-team).

interface.shortDescription: Consult distilled personas of colleagues, locally.
interface.longDescription: Build structured personas of colleagues from their Slack history, then consult them locally — get one colleague's likely take with ask-colleague, or convene a deliberating panel with ask-team. Personas capture what someone knows, believes, and how they decide. They are simulations, not the real people.
